rule_source: SRD 5.2 Rules Glossary: Temporary Hit Points
trigger: An affected creature with a current temporary HP pool gains another one
cost: No additional action to decide; originating effect retains its cost
choices: Keep the existing pool or replace it, including smaller offers and equal amounts from distinct sources; never stack

build: Paladin, target may be another duelist or companion
rule_source: SRD 5.2 Heroism; SRD 5.2 Temporary Hit Points
trigger: At the start of an eligible target turn during active Heroism
cost: Concentration for future grants; grants already received last until depleted or a Long Rest
choices: Keep or replace an existing pool; spell ending stops future refresh and immunity

rule_source: SRD 5.2 Fiendish Vigor; SRD 5.2 Temporary Hit Points
cost: Magic action; highest possible False Life grant
choices: Choose new grant or preserve the existing pool; no slot is spent

rule_source: SRD 5.2 Wild Shape, Dark One's Blessing, and Temporary Hit Points
trigger: On entering Wild Shape or Dark One's Blessing triggering at a qualifying defeat
cost: Original feature costs; no extra action for choosing a temporary pool
choices: Choose either temporary HP pool without summing them
